results.description:
Have you ever wanted to maintain your bike yourself? 

Bike Doctor 2.0 has been created to make bicycle maintenance as simple as possible. 

Not everyone is a technically minded bike mechanic. Sometimes, reading the instructions for a bike repair, it can feel that way. That's why we've designed Bike Doctor to be as easy to follow as possible. Making it suitable even for a complete beginner. It is an app I wish I had available to me, when I first started cycling. 

Using the step by step instructions you will: 
◆ Save money on bike shop repairs (Even a simple puncture repair in a bike shop costs upwards of $15) 
◆ Know how to detect problems 
◆ Repair any issues that arise, such as squeaks and poor performance 
◆ Learn how to safety check your bike to be sure it is always ready to ride 
◆ Keep your bike running smoothly for years to come 

Inside the Bike Doctor app you'll discover: 
◆ How to repair and prevent punctures 
◆ How to detect if your brake pads are worn out and replace them (Including Disk Brakes) 
◆ How to clean your bike 
◆ How to lubricate your bike 
◆ The 7 rookie bicycle maintenance mistakes you should avoid 
◆ How to adjust your headset 
◆ How to wrap handlebar tape 
◆ How to adjust your gears 
◆ How to true a bicycle wheel 
◆ How to fit a new chain and rear cassette(A very common yearly repair!) 
◆ How to bleed disk brakes 
◆ How to remove and replace a bottom bracket 
◆ How to replace brake and gear cables 
◆ And that's just scratching the surface! We've got all the most common repairs in the app and we're constantly asking for feedback from users of our app to discover what repairs they would like added - and then adding these in. 

Bike Doctor 2.0 is the new version of the original best-selling Bike Doctor. The original version has been downloaded over 10,000 times and received coverage in some of the most popular cycling magazines including Bicycling and Cycling Plus. 

The Bicycle is the ultimate in independence - learn how to keep yours maintained and in tip-top condition to insure it is always ready to get you to your destination! 

Here are some of the many 5 star reviews we've received: 
"I'm over the moon with this app I read somewhere about truing wheels and it said don't bother unless you are a pro, but I've just sorted my wheels out a treat. The app paid for itself straight away."

results.description:
Trail Hits shows you what your bike actually needs, based on real ride data, not a calendar.

PREDICTIVE BIKE MAINTENANCE
Every ride stresses your bike differently. A gnarly enduro trail wears your chain and brake pads faster than a mellow after-work spin. Trail Hits calculates real wear on every component from your ride data: elevation, speed, duration, and terrain.

KNOW YOUR WEAR, COMPONENT BY COMPONENT
Chain, brake pads, fork service, shock service, tires, bearings, all at a glance. Health indicators show which parts need service soon and which are still good. No more guessing when the chain is due.

CONNECT YOUR RIDES, AUTOMATICALLY
Connect Strava, Garmin, Wahoo, Hammerhead Karoo, or Ride with GPS. Every ride imports automatically and applies strain to the right component. You ride, Trail Hits does the math. No GPS? Log any ride manually.

SUSPENSION SETUP AND THE PROBLEM SOLVER
Document your setup: sag, rebound, compression, air pressure. When the bike feels off, the Problem Solver walks you through what to adjust, then logs whether it got better, so the next change is smarter than the last. The setup diary saves every change, on which trail and in what conditions.

DIAL CHEAT SHEET
Rebound too fast? Compression too stiff? The built-in cheat sheet explains every adjuster on your fork and shock, what it does and how to set it. No wrench degree required.

BUILT FOR eBIKES AND eMTBs
Motor torque accelerates chain and drivetrain wear 2 to 3 times faster than pedaling alone. Trail Hits accounts for it. Assist-level multipliers (Eco, Trail, Boost) apply different wear rates automatically, with weight-adjusted strain for heavier frames. Whether you ride a Specialized Turbo Levo or a Canyon Spectral:ON, Trail Hits tracks what your motor does to your components.

THE WHOLE QUIVER
Manage every bike: MTB, road, gravel, eBike, fat bike, adaptive. Each with its own components, ride history, and setup. Track parts by brand, model, and install date. Customize service intervals. See ride stats: distance, elevation, time, and strain.

YOUR BIKE'S SERVICE HISTORY, CONNECTED TO YOUR SHOP
If your local shop runs Trail Hits Hub, the work they complete becomes part of your bike's permanent record, like a Carfax for your bike. Your mechanic sees your bike component condition and can recommend service before something breaks.

SERVICE ESTIMATES IN APP
Trail Hits Hub shops can send you estimates to review, approve, decline, or ask questions about all in app.  Alternatively, shops can choose to send your estimates through email or SMS. 

BIKE SHOP: REQUEST A SERVICE APPOINTMENT
Trail Hits will surface your components that are 20% less, as well as an easy to use form

BIKE SHOP: SERVICE INSPECTIONS and ESTIMATES
Delivered directly to you in app, email, or SMS.  You can review, approve some, approve all, or decline estimates. 

BIKE SHOP: IN APP MESSAGING
Speak with your shop directly in app about your estimate to ask for revisions, clarifications, or when your bike can be done.

BIKE SHOP: WATCH YOUR BIKE PROGRESS
Real time status of your bike from received, in stand, to ready for pick-up. The best part is your shop just works as they always do.


Your bike deserves more than a calendar reminder. Trail Hits knows the difference between 500 km of fire road and 500 km of bike park.

Free for your first 10 rides or if your local shop uses Trail Hits Hub. No credit card.


Works with Strava, Garmin, Wahoo, Hammerhead Karoo, Apple Health, and Ride with GPS.

Increase your resale value, stay ahead of maintenance, and generate a professional service history in seconds. Moto Shed is a clean, ad-free maintenance app designed for riders and vehicle owners who want complete control of their service records, parts, and ownership costs.

Track maintenance, fuel usage, upgrades, and reminders for every motorcycle and vehicle you own.

Motorcycle Maintenance and Service Logging
Record oil changes, tire replacements, valve adjustments, chain service, repairs, upgrades, and parts. Create a complete service history with mileage, parts, labor, and detailed notes so you always know exactly what has been done to your motorcycle, car, truck, or other vehicle.

Fuel and Mileage Tracking
Log fuel fill-ups and fuel costs while tracking long-term mileage and fuel economy trends. Understand how your riding and driving habits affect fuel usage and ownership costs.

Smart Maintenance Reminders
Never forget important service again. Set reminders for oil changes, tire replacement, valve checks, belts, chain maintenance, inspections, insurance, and registration. Alerts can be based on time, mileage, or both. You can also create fully custom maintenance items for any vehicle.

Custom Maintenance Tracking
Track anything you want, not just predefined service items. Create custom repairs, upgrades, inspections, modifications, or recurring maintenance tasks tailored to your motorcycle, car, truck, or project vehicle.

VIN Recall Monitoring
Enter your motorcycle VIN to receive automatic NHTSA recall alerts and safety notifications so you stay informed about manufacturer recalls that may affect your bike.

Cost and Ownership Tracking
Moto Shed automatically tracks parts, labor, fuel, and repairs so you can understand the true cost of owning your motorcycle and other vehicles over time.

Garage Organization
Store everything related to your vehicles in one place including photos, part numbers, owner manuals, service notes, and documentation.

Professional Sales Report
Generate a clean PDF service history report when selling your motorcycle or vehicle. A detailed maintenance record helps build buyer confidence and can increase resale value.

Full Data Control
Export your service history via CSV. Backup and restore your garage using JSON when switching devices so your data always stays under your control.

Flexible and Personalized
Customize service intervals, categories, maintenance items, reminders, and alerts to match your motorcycle, vehicle, and maintenance habits. Choose from multiple themes and organize your garage the way you prefer.

Built for Every Garage
Moto Shed works for sport bikes, cruisers, touring motorcycles, dirt bikes, scooters, electric motorcycles, cars, trucks, SUVs, and project vehicles.

Global Support
Moto Shed supports miles or kilometers, multiple currencies, and 10 languages including English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, French, German, Vietnamese, and Portuguese.

Keep your maintenance history organized, track ownership costs, and make sure your bikes and vehicles always run their best with Moto Shed.
